Aveleda

Aveleda Alvarinho

WhiteControlled Designation of Origin (DOC) Vinho Verde

Single-variety Alvarinho Vinho Verde from the Aveleda house, more aromatic and fuller-bodied than traditional blended Vinho Verde.

Aveleda is one of the leading family companies of Vinho Verde, based at Quinta da Aveleda, in Penafiel. Besides high-volume brands such as Casal Garcia, it makes a range of wines under its own name, among them this single-variety Alvarinho (Albariño).

Alvarinho, the same variety known in Galicia as Albariño, is a thick-skinned, small-bunched grape that gives wines that are more aromatic, fuller-bodied and longer-lived than light blended Vinho Verde. It is grown mainly in the north of the region beside the river Minho, although today it is also planted in other subregions. The wine ferments in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks to preserve varietal aromas, and may rest for a time on fine lees before bottling. It sees no oak and lacks the spritz typical of other Vinho Verde.

It is a fresh, expressive white intended to be drunk in its first years, although it can develop well for some time in bottle.

Tasting profile

Pale yellow. Aromas of peach, apricot, citrus and white flowers. Fresh, flavourful palate with good acidity and an aromatic finish.

Food pairing

Shellfish, grilled fish, ceviche, Asian cuisine, fresh cheeses

Serving

8-10 °C, white wine glass
